author: zAllaa
quote: it doesn’t even feel like a GTA game. Rockstar got so obsessed with "realism" that they turned it into a sims game. Everything takes forever and you barely have money after hours of play, clunky movement AND YOU CANT STEAL CARS THATS WORTH IT. it’s just annoying busywork instead of actual fun. GTA used to be about jumping in, causing chaos, and having freedom, not doing chores just to play the game. They completely lost the GTA DNA.I kept playing past the 2-hour mark hoping it would finally pick up, and now I'm stuck with it. Really wish I refunded it when I had the chance
